Profanation does not consume the altar or prevent an ally from worshipping there.

Defiance 0/100; Elder Rites 0/3.

abilities.name: Invoke Elder Rites
abilities.desc:
At XL9, XL15 and XL21, complete one short two-wave encounter to strengthen all your stolen benefits. Begin on safe open ground. Only one party rite can be active on a floor.
